purpose: Explain model-attributed charging CO2, selected-period evidence, lifetime context, grid-model coverage and bounded green-window scenarios.
primaryGoal: Compare charging emissions with the fixed gas baseline and evaluate timing opportunities without confusing static-model scenarios with live grid data or executable schedules.

dataSources.ownership: Shared vehicle-independent static model; backend CarbonHandler.Intensity.
dataSources.behavior: Always enabled; ['carbon-intensity']; STALE_TIMES.STATIC; AbortSignal forwarded. Curve, min/max, greenest/dirtiest hour sets; hour timezone is not exposed.
Positive vehicle ID required; key includes vehicle/from/to; ANALYTICS stale time; signal forwarded; URLSearchParams encodes both bounds.

dataSources.ownership: Separate full-history vehicle summary, not a selected-period fallback.
dataSources.behavior: Same hook with null bound key slots; independent request and recovery; lifetime denominator supports period shares, timing score and scenario math.
Positive vehicle ID required; ['carbon-recommendation', vehicleId]; ANALYTICS stale time; signal forwarded; deliberately independent of selected range.

duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse a domain-level presentation adapter where provenance/scope needs permit; preserve evidence-specific accessible section name and invalid-window warning.

issues.detail: Fixed dual-axis gutter widths and month labels leave limited plot space in a 320px allocated container; no page-specific small-width tick-density policy is supplied. This is a source-backed risk, not observed clipping.
issues.fix: Validate narrow allocated widths and long localized labels; adapt chart ticks/gutters using the existing chart contract without dropping either series or the data-table alternative.

responsive.runtimeStatus: All ten mandated widths, text zoom, RTL and touch scrolling unverified.

observed: Named chart sections and aria descriptions, structured accessible dataColumns, table aria-labels and row header scope are present.
Source status includes words, not color alone; retry Buttons have visible localized text.
CarbonSectionBody.tsx:100 announces loading through role=status; decorative icons mostly explicitly aria-hidden.
OperationalBrief.tsx:118 names sections by title ID; its Review details action uses the existing Drawer.
FadeIn.tsx:31 suppresses initial animation under reduced-motion preference.

issues.detail: The mounted three-column hourly directory has row headings but no column headings identifying intensity and band. The table label describes the overall table, not those column relationships.
issues.fix: Add localized column headings using the existing semantic Table; preserve rank/hour row headers and every band/intensity value.

accessibility.runtimeStatus: Keyboard order, drawer focus trapping/restoration, screen-reader announcements, table scroll keyboard reachability, effective contrast, forced colors and 44px targets unverified.

states.loading: Four source states are independent; initial source skeletons and brief loading suppression retain section shells.
states.empty: Selected-period valid-zero message, monthly and curve EmptyState, lifetime unsupported-score EmptyState, recommendation empty/invalid messages are present.
states.error: Fatal source failure has SourceContent recovery plus source-ledger retry; errors do not gate all page content.
states.retained: queryState.ts:34-35 separates fatal and refresh errors; cached payloads remain available; CarbonSourceRow.tsx:126-153 provides retry refresh and paused-refresh explanation.
states.offline: Paused initial and retained requests receive different messages; no independent invented offline source is used.
states.partialUnknown: Curve coverage and invalid rows are accounted for; unknown/invalid numeric values remain null; reconciliation availability is explicit.

issues.detail: A successfully resolved empty or entirely invalid intensity curve renders an empty tbody in this directory, without an empty/invalid explanation. Neighboring curve and coverage sections do not explain this table locally.
issues.fix: Render an explicit empty/invalid state inside the retained directory section when rankedRows is empty; retain its statistics, scope and retry behavior.

issues.detail: combinedState overrides hasData/loading/refresh fields but inherits isResolved, isPaused, error and onRetry solely from recommendation. If recommendation succeeds and lifetime fatally fails or pauses initially, the outer wrapper can show pending rather than the actual lifetime failure and suppress the nested lifetime recovery.
issues.fix: Compose both source trust states with the existing deriveDataState/aggregateDataState pipeline or preserve separate visible source boundaries; bind recovery to the failed source, not recommendation by default.

issues.detail: Domain query adapter drops dataUpdatedAt and source age. CarbonSectionBody.tsx:51 passes a boolean payload without timestamps, so source-level age/freshness cannot be shown. PageContainer can still show its aggregate query freshness; this is not a claim that the entire page has no freshness.
issues.fix: Forward the existing canonical data-state freshness metadata and provide actual source freshness to OperationalBrief; do not label successful old cache as fresh without age evidence.

visualIssues.detail: Feature-local fixed amber #f59e0b and bright cyan #22d3ee bypass shared theme/chart palette preferences.
visualIssues.fix: Consume existing restrained chart palette while retaining clearly differentiated CO2 bars and energy line; preserve opt-in saved chart/theme choices.

visualIssues.detail: Fixed teal/green/rose colors (lines 22-24), area gradient opacity 0.4, and clean/dirty reference strokes at 0.8 create avoidable saturated decoration and competing annotation weight.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing palette/tokens, reduce decorative fill and reference-line intensity without removing extrema or changing data meaning.

visualIssues.detail: Gauge has feature-local fixed rose/amber/emerald threshold colors; meaning is supported by labels but presentation bypasses semantic chart tokens.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing semantic gauge colors without altering the 35/70 thresholds, numeric score, support-session requirement or disclaimer.

architectureIssues.detail: Current CarbonSummary wire/cache type still exposes total_energy_kwh and monthly.energy_kwh. carbonIntelligence.ts:437,484 normalizes these once to Wh after query caching. This is a real inherited SI-boundary exception, not permission to blindly rename or multiply a future SI payload.
architectureIssues.fix: Coordinate a backend/API-contract migration outside the page item. Until verified server shape changes, preserve current once-only conversion and document the exception; do not introduce dual-shape guesses.

priority.rationale: Fix multi-source opportunity trust/recovery first, then directory empty/semantic gaps and palette consistency. Preserve the unusually complete existing evidence and caveat sections.

competingImplementations.detail: The barrel still exports eight original carbon presentation components while the mounted page aliases eight Carbon*Brief replacements from operationalbrief-a-m. Original CarbonEvidenceLedger.tsx:32 uses text StatStrip metrics; mounted CarbonEvidenceBrief.tsx:17 uses numeric OperationalBrief metrics. Original CarbonHourlyDirectory.tsx:42 separately implements the same directory/band pattern.
competingImplementations.fix: Keep the mounted implementation as the audited authority. Establish actual consumers before any later consolidation; do not delete unmounted candidates on name similarity or re-adopt text metrics.
competingImplementations.evidenceLimit: Only two original bodies were sampled; other exports were enumerated, not semantically audited. Whole-app usage/dead-code status is unknown.

dataBehavior: Four independent queries; do not substitute lifetime rows for unavailable selected-period monthly data.
Null/invalid inputs remain unknown, zero remains valid, signed net avoided mass remains negative for excess emissions.

Legacy total_energy_kwh/monthly.energy_kwh multiply by 1000 once in carbonIntelligence.ts:437,484; raw existing cache payload is unchanged. Canonical analytical energy is Wh, inferred distance m, CO2 mass kg; model intensity explicitly g CO2/kWh and clock hours are source-domain quantities.
Display-only energy/distance conversion uses useUnits and convertEnergyFromSI; localized precision and locale remain reactive (useCarbonDisplay.ts:14-32). Do not guess backend changes.
Model curve validation rejects invalid hour/intensity rows, retains first valid duplicate-hour row deterministically, computes coverage and ranks without fabricated missing points.
Monthly rows sort by YYYY-MM and retain duplicate detection; period shares require positive lifetime denominator (carbonIntelligence.ts:437-580).
Gas baseline remains 0.192 kg CO2/km; rounding tolerances energyWh=5, massKg=0.005, intensity=0.05, percentage=0.05 (carbonIntelligence.ts:6-13).
Recommendation validates a wrapping three-hour window and lifetime inputs; recalculated saving clips at zero, unlike signed gas-baseline net comparison (carbonIntelligence.ts:632-717).
Backend model attribution timezone is not exposed; never relabel clock-hour as vehicle-local or claim live/location-aware/marginal emissions.
All thirteen sections remain reachable without an all-page data gate; extracted components count toward preservation.
